title: Casimir Force in Spacetimes with Torsion
summary: We compute the Casimir force between perfectly conducting parallel plates in a spacetime endowed with constant axial torsion. Working within an effective field theory framework where torsion couples to the electromagnetic sector via a gauge-invariant Chern--Simons-type interaction, we derive the modified photon dispersion relation and mode spectrum. Using zeta-function regularization, we obtain the vacuum energy and the resulting Casimir pressure to second order in the torsion parameter.
